"''Well, a girl's gotta make a living.|Ahsoka Tano and Aurra Sing|}} '''Aurra Sing''', also known by the name "'''Nashtah'''," was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Gender|female]] [[Palliduvan]] who left the [[Jedi Order]] to take up the life of a [[bounty hunter]]. Operating prior to and during the [[Clone Wars]], she was present on [[Tatooine]], where she watched the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]], during the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. During this [[time]], she also became acquainted with [[Weequay]] [[pirate]] [[captain]], [[Hondo Ohnaka]]. After the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars and the [[death]] of fellow [[bounty]] hunter [[Jango Fett]], Sing trained Fett's son, [[Boba Fett]], and helped him in an unsuccessful attempt to kill [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]], who killed Jango on [[Geonosis]]. After parting ways with Boba, Sing took jobs from [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro the Hutt]] and [[Cad Bane]]. Sing's long and storied career, however, ultimately came to an end with her death at the hands of [[Tobias Beckett]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|I have a bad feeling about this, Bane. Our employer seems capable enough. Why does he need us?|Aurra, to Cad Bane on Darth Maul|}} [[File:MaulSingBaneVorhdeilo-2017DarthMaul2.png|thumb|left|180px|Sing meets the Sith Lord Darth Maul]] [[Reproduction|Born]] in [[51 BBY]] on her [[homeworld]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] to a [[Aurra Sing's father|father]] she never knew and a [[spice]]-addicted{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Chrome Perspectives|subset=Jedi Temple Archives|cardname=Aurra Sing|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/114595/cid/8022643/2015-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-Perspectives-Jedi-vs.-Sith-39-J-Aurra-Sing}} [[Aurra Sing's mother|mother]] too poor to raise her, Aurra Sing was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Palliduvan]] who became part of the [[Jedi Order]]. Eventually she left the Order to become a [[bounty hunter]], taking her [[lightsaber]] with her. She was trained as a killing machine by [[Anzati]] agents. She later told others of her past with the [[Jedi]], but her word was not taken as fact by the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]]. She was also known by the name "Nashtah." As a feared hunter known for her chalk-[[Color|white]] skin and built-in [[comlink]] [[antenna]], Aurra Sing was an expert [[sniper]] and trained [[assassin]] who would work for anyone who paid her. She was a known associate of [[Jango Fett]] and was at one point involved in a relationship with Ohnaka.{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}} On Nar Shaddaa, she and fellow bounty hunters Cad Bane and [[Vorhdeilo]] met [[Sith Lord]], [[Maul|Darth Maul]]. Sing picked up a transmission that Jedi were on their way to [[Hutta Town]] to investigate. Together with [[Cad Bane's group|Bane's group]], despite Sing's suspicions about Maul, they attended [[Xev Xrexus]]'s [[Xrexus Cartel|Cartel's]] [[Auction of Eldra Kaitis|auction]] of the Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Eldra Kaitis]]. During the auction, Sing, Bane, and Vorhdeilo spoke with Maul aboard their [[Starship|ship]]. Together, they planned to take Kaitis from [[Jee Kra]], who had successfully won the padawan in the auction. Sing and her compatriots [[Death|killed]] Kra's crew. Sing, Maul, and the others met Kra and Kaitis at his ship. After Maul subdued Kra and his remaining crew, Sing spoke with Bane about about leaving or killing Maul after their job was done. Having discovered the theft, Xrexus ordered the ship shot down.[[Darth Maul (2017) 3|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 3]] After the group crashed onto the [[moon of Drazkel]] below, Xrexus allowed the rest of the bidders to [[Skirmish on the moon of Drazkel|hunt]] them down for sport and offered Kaitis to anyone who captured her. Maul and Kaitis split off from the group to distract the hunters, instructing the bounty hunters to steal a ship. Turning the tables on the hunters, Bane, Sing, and Vorhdeilo set a trap. Bane lured a group of [[Trandoshan]] hunters into a kill zone, where Sing sniped them from a distance and Vorhdeilo attacked them at close range.[[Darth Maul (2017) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 4]] The group then stole a [[Ohnaka Gang]] starship and picked up Maul, who promised they would be compensated.[[Darth Maul (2017) 5|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 5]] [[File:Aurra_sing_ep1.png|thumb|right|230px|Aurra at the Boonta Eve Classic]] Ten [[Standard year|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis|start]] of the [[Clone Wars]], Sing was on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Tatooine]] during the [[time]] of the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]]. Sing watched the podrace from a balcony on [[Beggar's Canyon]], and became impressed by the flying skills displayed by Anakin Skywalker. A [[hologram]] image depicting [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] paying Sing as two of his underlings dragged the injured [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Neva Kee]] away from his crashed [[Podracer]] was acquired some time later by the [[Coruscant Security Force]] [[Law enforcement agency|police]] [[inspector]] [[Tanivos Exantor Divo|Tan Divo]]. All identifying authentimarks were scrubbed from the hologram, making it impossible to confirm its legitimacy, but if true, the image suggested Sing had a hand in Kee's demise. Divo developed a theory that [[Farwan & Glott]], the original manufacturers of Kee's podracer, hired Sing to take out Kee so that they could acquire the podracer customization secrets that he refused to reveal. ===Halcyon Legacy=== {{Quote|My name is Colman Vestig, and I'm looking to--"
"That's a lot of credits. So, who do you need "taken care of"?|Colman Vestig and Aurra Sing|[[Halcyon Legacy 2|''Halcyon Legacy'' 2]]}} [[File:ColramVestigAurraSing-HalcyonLegacy2.jpg|thumb|left|265px|Colram Vestig hires Aurra Sing]] At some point prior to [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] to the year [[22 BBY]]. Because the death of [[Zam Wesell]] is depicted in that film, and a living Wesell appears in flashbacks in [[Halcyon Legacy 2|''Halcyon Legacy'' 2]], those flashbacks must have taken place before 22 BBY. Sing was vacationing aboard the ''[[Halcyon]]'', along with the [[Clawdite]] bounty hunter, [[Zam Wesell]], where she was hired by a [[Gender|man]] named [[Colram Vestig]] for protection against the [[Hutt Clan|Hutts]], whom he owed a great sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. As Vestig was negotiating with Sing, his son [[Wilmar]] approached to pester his father about his promises to let him join a safari to the [[planet]] [[Numidian Prime]] to see the native [[Predavorexx]]es. Vestig shooed his child away, and soon after, they were approached by a representative of the Hutts aboard the ''Halcyon''. Sing attacked the man, but he informed her and Vestig that his bosses now had possession of the boy, and they followed him to Numidian Prime to [[Rescue of Wilmar|retrieve]] him. As they were departing the ship, the [[droid]] [[D3-O9]] warned Sing that the ''Halcyon'' was approaching a [[solar storm]], which had caused all other passenger excursions from departing as scheduled. This, however, did not deter the bounty hunter. They were led to a band of [[Weequay]]s, who had Wilmar held at gunpoint. They let loose a wild Predavorexx to attack Sing, much to the alarm of the representative who had been sent to collect Sing, who was still down on the ground with her when the creature attacked. The Hutts began to gamble on Sing's chances of success, but to their collective dismays, Aurra came out victorious in the match. With the help of Wesell, who had taken on the form of a Weequay in order to sneak behind the child's captors, Sing defeated the Weequays. She then returned to the transport and flew back to the ''Halcyon'', where she returned Wilmar to Vestig. The ''Halcyon'' narrowly avoided the solar storm. Shortly after, the Hutts finalized their purchase of the pleasure vessel, and so the bounty hunter pair decided to cut their vacation short and slink off at the next [[spaceport]]. ===The Clone Wars=== ====Joining Boba Fett==== {{Quote|I just wanted to kill the Jedi that murdered my father!''"
"''Well, that will have to wait. Grow up. You'll get your revenge in time.|Boba Fett and Aurra Sing|{{TCW|Death Trap}}}} [[File:Slave_I_airlock.png|thumb|right|290px|Aurra on board ''Slave I'' with Bossk]] Sing's work as an expert sniper and the skills she displayed in in that field around the time of the [[Clone Wars]] earned her fame.{{Topps|set=2022 Topps Star Wars Masterwork|subset=Bounty Hunting: A Complicated Profession|cardname=Aurra Sing|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/399146/cid/23267443}} During the Clone Wars, Sing joined up with [[Boba Fett]] to kill [[Mace Windu]] for revenge for Boba's [[Parent|father]], who Windu had killed on [[Geonosis]]. Boba, under the name of "Lucky," boarded the ''[[Endurance]]'' as a [[clone cadet]]. After his first attempt on Windu's life failed, he contacted Sing to ask for advice. Sing told him to blow up the [[reactor]]s, much to Boba's surprise. After Boba successfully destroyed the ''Endurance''{{'s}} reactors, sending it crashing towards [[Vanqor]], he got into one of the [[escape pod]]s along with several of the other [[cadet]]s. Once they were away from the plummeting vessel, the pod was docked by ''[[Slave I]]''. [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] and Sing entered the pod to confront Boba. After telling him that the other cadets must be launched into [[Realspace|space]], due to the fact that they were "living witnesses," Boba reluctantly came aboard ''Slave I'' and jettisoned the pod from ''Slave I''{{'s}} docking area. Although the group of [[bounty]] hunters escaped, the cadets were saved by the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and Windu, who had escaped the ''Endurance'' in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Jedi starfighters]]. Sing and her crew reached the crashed cruiser before the Jedi. There, she encountered and executed multiple clone survivors, shooting them in the back or chest. She later abducted [[Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian|Kilian]], [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Ponds]], and a [[Clone navigation officer|naval officer]] from the crash site of the ''Endurance'' on Vanqor. After Skywalker and Windu triggered their bomb in the crash site, Boba [[Mission to Vanqor|convinced]] Sing to go back to get the two Jedi's heads to bring to [[Count]] [[Dooku]], who might pay them for their trouble. Sing, along with Boba and [[Castas]], went to the crash site. Due to the ship falling apart, and [[R2-D2]]'s interference, Sing decided to blow up the crash site. As they left, Bossk contacted Sing, telling that a explosion happened near where the Jedi landed. Sing then ordered Bossk to jam all transmissions from the planet. When Sing and her team returned to ''Slave I'', they saw Windu's Jedi [[starfighter]] taking off. Unbeknownst to Sing, only R2-D2 was aboard. Though ''Slave I'' took out the Jedi fighter's communications, Artoo reached the [[Hyperspace transport ring|hyperspace rings]] and escaped. Knowing that Windu would not hold a grudge against them, she decided to motivate Windu by using the hostages.{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} [[File:AhsokaGotsSing-LT.png|thumb|left|250px|Aurra Sing caught by Ahsoka Tano]] When contacting Windu to come and find her, Sing shot Ponds and later ejected his body into space after Boba wouldn't do it. The group of bounty hunters then traveled to the planet [[Florrum]] for a visit with Sing's old flame Hondo Ohnaka, hoping for advice. During a visit in the [[Cantina|bar]] with Ohnaka, Sing, using her [[biocomputer]], overheard Castas communicating via hologram to a friend on [[Coruscant]]. After hearing him calling her an "old hag" and offer up information about her, Sing took out her [[blaster]], called Castas' name, and shot him in the face when he turned around, killing him. [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] and the Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano]] later [[Second mission to Florrum|caught up]] with her, having learned of her location via Castas' killing, and a standoff ensued with Boba holding a blaster to Koon's head and Tano a lightsaber to Sing's throat. Though Koon attempted to defuse the situation peacefully by promising no harm would come to the two if they yielded, Sing refused to do so and tried to kill the Jedi Master with darts concealed in her boot. The attempt failed and the situation turned violent; Sing took advantage of a bomb triggered by Boba to escape, but abandoned her protege despite his pleas after Koon managed to capture him. Stealing a speeder bike from a pirate, Sing led a pursuing Tano on a chase away from where the hostages were located but when Tano broke off pursuit to head in the correct direction after being informed of this, Sing took another path and ambushed the Jedi just as she freed the hostages. The Palliduvan boarded ''Slave I'' and powered it up, intending to flee, but the ship ended up crashing after a wing was sliced off by the Jedi Padawan. Sing was presumed dead by the Jedi. Unknown to them, Hondo salvaged her out of ''Slave I''{{'s}} wreckage. ====Working for Ziro==== {{Quote|Honey, this isn't about your cause. This is about revenge. My employer wants to get even with you. Simple as that.|Aurra Sing, to Padmé Amidala|}} [[File:AurraSing-Assassin.png|thumb|right|270px|Sing facing Ahsoka Tano]] Quickly returning to work after her apparent death, Sing was later hired by [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]] the [[Hutt]] to assassinate [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] in retaliation for [[Raid on Ziro's Palace|imprisoning]] him. She tracked the Senator to [[Alderaan]], where Amidala was due for a [[Alderaan Refugee Conference|conference]] on [[refugee]] concerns. Infiltrating the conference through the vents and snapping the neck of several [[Senate Commando]]s, Sing set up a sniper position. Only the timely intervention of Tano saved Amidala from suffering a fatal wound, forcing Sing to flee. Sing later made a second attempt on Amidala's life when she tracked down the Senator, not being fooled by the [[BD-3000 luxury droid]] acting in her place, but was once again foiled by Tano. Sing outdrew Tano as she grazed the Padawan, but was caught off-guard as Amidala pulled a hidden blaster and hit her with a [[stun]] blast, knocking her out. Sing was then arrested and brought to Coruscant; her failure to assassinate her target was exploited to garner an accidental confession from Ziro, guaranteeing her employer an extended [[prison]] sentence. ====Senate hostages==== {{Quote|Help me…no…n-|A Senate Commando, before being killed by Aurra Sing|{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}}} [[File:Aura_Cad_Bane.png|thumb|left|240px|Sing working with Cad Bane]] Later in the Clone Wars, Sing escaped [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] captivity and teamed up with [[Cad Bane]]'s bounty hunter team for the [[Senate hostage crisis|raid]] on the Republic [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]], with the object of taking hostages to free Ziro the Hutt from his imprisonment. During the hostage siege Aurra covered Bane's entrance to the building by positioning herself at the top of a nearby building and taking out the Senate Commandos who attempted to stop him with a [[sniper rifle]]. After Bane eliminated the remaining Senate Commandos, Sing shot a dying trooper who was lying on the ground. Later she aided [[Shahan Alama]] in searching for Anakin Skywalker, whose presence in the Senate Building threatened to thwart Bane's plan. Eventually, with the help of [[Robonino]], the hunters managed to render Skywalker unconscious. When the Hutt [[crime lord]] was freed, Sing successfully left the crime scene along with the rest of the group. While escaping, Sing and the others were pursued by the Jedi into one of Coruscant's [[underworld portal]]s. Bane shot the engine of an ascending [[transport]] ship, which caused it to spin out of control and force the Jedi to steered it clear of a populated landing platform, allowing Sing and the rest of Bane's crew to escape with their bounty.{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}} ===Further work and death=== {{Quote|You're Tobias Beckett. You killed Aurra Sing."
"Pushed her. Pretty sure the fall killed her.|Lando Calrissian and Tobias Beckett|''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''}} [[File:TobiasBeckett-SASWSOCE.png|thumb|Tobias Beckett (pictured) killed Aurra Sing.]] As the Clone Wars continued, Sing eventually took to [[Commanding officer|commanding]] forces from the [[Confederacy military]]. The Jedi agreed to personally capture her. The Republic put out a warning to its citizens about the bounty hunter, asking its people not engage her and instead immediately report any sighting to the [[Jedi High Council]]. However, the citizen's alert also incorrectly stated her career in bounty [[hunting]] had lasted seven [[Standard decade|decades]] by that point. At some point, the [[smuggler]] and entrepreneur [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] accrued a large debt to Sing. Around [[13 BBY]], [[Tobias Beckett]] took a job for [[Crimson Dawn]] crime lord [[Dryden Vos]] and eventually killed Sing by pushing her from a substantial height.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' ===Legacy=== Sing's death pleased Vos, and he gave Beckett a bonus for the act. Sing's death was later recalled to Beckett while talking with Calrissian, who was also pleased by her demise due to the sum that he had owed her, though Beckett claimed that he had merely only pushed Sing and that it was, in fact, the fall that had killed her. Sing's former flame Hondo Ohnaka included her in his book ''[[The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]'' and reflected on his past with her. While he believed the galaxy was safer with her dead, he found that there were times when he missed his old lover. Sing was also mentioned in Ohnaka's book the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''.''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' In [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Halcyon Legacy 2|''Halcyon Legacy'' 2]] to [[34 ABY]]. during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], the droid D3-O9 told the tale of her exploits with Zam Wesell during their stay aboard the ''Halcyon'', reflecting that both bounty hunters had met their fates. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Next time I tell you to pull the trigger, you do it.|Aurra Sing, to Boba Fett|}} [[File:Aurra_Sing_takes_aim.png|thumb|270px|Aurra takes aim|left]] Aurra Sing was a Palliduvan female who stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]]) tall, with [[Color|auburn]] [[hair]], green [[eye]]s and white skin. Sing was known as one of the most powerful and ruthless bounty hunters in [[the galaxy]]. She had no qualms about killing, whether it be executing wounded [[clone trooper]]s, former partners like Castas or setting adolescent clones adrift in a disabled escape pod. Despite her ruthlessness, Sing was also somewhat of a mother figure to Boba Fett during his teenage years, sometimes addressing him as "Honey" and stopping him from drinking [[alcohol]] in Hondo Ohnaka's bar. Despite this, she was also selfish, and she abandoned Fett to save herself after the boy was captured by Plo Koon. Sing also tried to serve as a mentor to Fett, as shown by when she tried to make him murder the helpless Clone Commander Ponds and when he hesitated, she simply shoved him aside and killed Ponds herself. Aurra Sing also had a romantic relationship with Hondo Ohnaka, and though they were no longer lovers, Ohnaka still referred to her as "My Dear." Consequently, after Sing and Boba arrived at Ohnaka's base, he asked if Boba was his son. Even with their past, Ohnaka refused to help Sing when she tried to lure Ahsoka Tano and Plo Koon into a trap. Like [[General]] [[Grievous]],{{Film|III}} Sing kept lightsabers as trophies from the Jedi she hunted.''[[Star Wars: Women of the Galaxy]]'' ==Skills and abilities== [[File:AurraSing-BHUSC.png|thumb|200px|Sing was equally deadly with a blaster pistol or sniper rifle.]] Sing was a very skilled markswoman, an expert sniper and a master assassin. Her skills as a vicious bounty hunter included being Force-sensitive. Sing's specialty was in political assassinations, and she counted raids, abductions and assassinations on the politicians, such as Padmé Amidala as a fast route to a big paycheck. Sing effortlessly shot several Senate Commandos with a sniper rifle without being seen and shot Alama's blaster out of Skywalker's hand. She possessed a considerable amount of strength as she snapped the neck of a Senate Commando and was even able to completely close her large hand around the smaller Ahsoka Tano's throat. Sing also was skilled at armed and unarmed combat, infiltration, surveillance and starship piloting. ==Equipment== Aurra Sing was known for her built-in comlink antenna. Her skull contained a [[Rhen-Orm]]''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' biocomputer that allowed her to track multiple threats simultaneously and to line up distant shots with her sniper rifle. It also gave her an early warning that authorities were closing in on her position. Sing wielded a pair of [[DX-13 blaster pistol]]s. Sing's [[Adventurer slugthrower rifle|Czerka Adventurer rifle]] enabled her to hit targets from incredible distances. She also wore a pair of well-worn boots made from rancor hide. The sniper rifle Sing used to attempt to assassinate Senator Amidala was compact enough to fit in a case, and when assembled, each piece can slot into each other. ==Behind the scenes== The character of Aurra Sing was first conceived by concept artist [[Doug Chiang]] in a sketch labeled "Babe Fett" made as a result of ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]]' request to have more characters fill out the podracing sequence in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. In the film, Sing was played by model [[Michonne Bourriague]].{{DB|character|aurrasing|Sing, Aurra}} She later reappeared in the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', first appearing in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|season one]] finale episode "[[Hostage Crisis]]". The character was voiced by [[Jaime King]] in the series. Concept art of her model for the series was done by [[Kilian Plunkett]].''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' A new model of Aurra Sing in a black "sniper outfit" was later created by Plunkett or the ''The Clone Wars'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|season three]] episode "[[Assassin (episode)|Assassin]]".{{Tumblr|subdomain=starwars|name=''Star Wars''|url=post/90790686408/auura-sing-concept-by-killian-plunkett|text=Auura Sing concept by Killian Plunkett.|archivedate=20181218163113}} The dark strip of makeup across her eyes in the episode is a homage to a similar look worn by [[Wikipedia:Daryl Hannah|Daryl Hannah]] in the [[1982]] film [[Wikipedia:Blade Runner|''Blade Runner'']], which also starred ''Star Wars'' actor [[Harrison Ford]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/assassin-trivia-gallery|text="Assassin" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} In May [[2018]], Kyle Newman, King's husband, revealed that Sing was planned to be killed in one of the unfinished episodes of the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of ''The Clone Wars''.{{YouTube|video=DU6WwLoQaqs|text=Solo Live Reaction|channel=channel/UCxnEDVUZe8-j61nKo4HzOYg|name=Steele Wars|date=2018-05-31|quote=You know, she actually died befo... There were episodes of The Clone Wars season 6 that I was in, which were deleted and she was in that too and she died.}} Concept art of Aurra Sing and Cad Bane with Boba Fett in [[Boba Fett's armor|his Mandalorian armor]] was revealed at the "The Untold ''Clone Wars'' Panel" at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim 2015]].{{SW|url=news/swca-the-untold-clone-wars-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: The Untold ''Clone Wars'' Panel Liveblog}} Sing's death was later revealed in the 2018 [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. ===Inconsistencies=== While [[Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine 2|''Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine'' 2]] and [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 76|''Star Wars Helmet Collection'' 76]] state Sing was half-[[human]],[[Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine 2|''Star Wars Jedi Master'' Magazine 2]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|76|Weapons & Uniforms}} her [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry, ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'',''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' say she was a [[Palliduvan]]. This article assumes ''Jedi Master Magazine'' 2 and ''Helmet Collection'' 76 are in error. The "Sith Fugitives" card for Sing claimed she had a seven-decade long career in bounty hunting by the Clone Wars, but ''Jedi Master Magazine'' 2 states she was only born in [[51 BBY]]. As the "Sith Fugitives" card represents an in-universe piece of [[propaganda]], this article assumes it as an in-universe error. ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox| {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Aurra Sing}}
